user.title: Connect to AdGuard Home
user.description: Kid Watch reads AdGuard Home's query log to see which apps and sites each child uses, and changes AdGuard's per-device settings when you press a control.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname, without http://
data_description.port: The port of AdGuard Home's web page (often 80 or 3000).

child.title: Add child {count}
child.description: Who are you adding, and which devices and TVs are theirs?

data_description.clients: From AdGuard Home's client list. Name devices in AdGuard first to make them easy to spot, or pick them by address.
data_description.tvs: TVs and streaming boxes in Home Assistant. Anything playing on these counts for this child.
data_description.plex_user: Their Plex home profile. Whatever they watch on Plex counts for them, on any TV.
data_description.age_limit: You get an alert when a show above this rating starts (UK ratings; US ratings are matched by age).
data_description.budget: Minutes a day. You get an alert when it's used up. 0 means no budget.
data_description.bedtime: Internet pauses at this time while the Bedtime switch is on.
data_description.wake_time: Internet comes back at this time after a bedtime pause.

data_description.notify_service: Any notify service: the Home Assistant phone app, Gotify, Telegram, email…
data_description.services: Each one becomes a block switch for every child.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach AdGuard Home. Check the address and port.
error.invalid_auth: AdGuard Home didn't accept the username or password.
error.name_taken: There's already a child with that name.
error.client_taken: One of these devices already belongs to another child.
error.nothing_to_watch: Pick at least one device, TV or Plex profile.

abort.already_configured: This AdGuard Home is already set up in Kid Watch.
